heading: Duty to maintain tax-exempt status
lead: The corporation shall maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Internal Revenue Code of 1986, referred to in text, is classified to Title 26, Internal Revenue Code.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 118–31, div. E, title LI, § 5103(a), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 937.)

ancestors.heading: PATRIOTIC AND NATIONAL OBSERVANCES, CEREMONIES, AND ORGANIZATIONS
